name: Second Harvest of Silicon Valley
description: Second Harvest of Silicon Valley is the food bank serving all of Santa Clara and San Mateo counties, where 1 in 6 people turn to it each month for nutritious food.
fullDescription: Second Harvest of Silicon Valley is the food bank serving all of Santa Clara and San Mateo counties, where 1 in 6 people turn to it each month for nutritious food.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free fresh groceries and ready-to-eat meals at sites across Santa Clara and San Mateo counties
- Online Food Locator to find sites by day and time
- Food Connection team to help you find food, in English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese, and Tagalog
- CalFresh enrollment assistance
- Referrals to Meals on Wheels, senior meal programs, and WIC
howToGetIt: Use the online Food Locator to choose fresh groceries or ready-to-eat meals and find days and times that fit your schedule, or call the Food Connection team at 1-800-984-3663. You can also request a call back in your preferred language.
keywords: Second Harvest, Silicon Valley, food bank, free food, food pantry, groceries, produce, ready-to-eat meals, CalFresh, Santa Clara, San Mateo
